scope: Only K-MOOC, Work24 and NCS catalog batches. User documents are separate private inputs.

mappings.name: courses.name
mappings.summary: raw HTML plus sanitized evidence; media is not curriculum proof
mappings.week/course_playtime/vod_playtime: raw values until source units are verified

adapters.id_policy: Keep source id, shortname and source occurrence identity; do not infer cross-cohort course equivalence. Detail enriches matching list item. Orphan detail is quarantined until a list match or validated standalone normalization.

mappings.curriculum: content evidence when present, null otherwise
mappings.course_id/offering_id/cohort: source identities when present; null preserved
mappings.source_excel_row: provenance only, not stable cross-file identity

adapters.id_policy: Use verified source IDs if present. Otherwise assign internal UUID and conservative fingerprint(provider,name,region,start,end). Exact fingerprint is a duplicate candidate, not authority to merge conflicting cohorts. A changed file row number never becomes a new global identity by itself.

Keep a real NCS code only if supplied. Otherwise internal UUID from kind + classification + name + source hash; never fabricate a national code. Equal names alone do not prove module/standard identity.

quality_rules: Array lengths are computed, never fixed to the old 20/10 samples.
Top-level record_count/row_count/totalCount are metadata, not sole truth; compare actual expected arrays.
Empty or malformed required array quarantines the batch; source errors do not publish an empty catalog.
Raw null/0/not_applicable are distinct. Unknown optional fields are preserved in raw_json and reported; incompatible required shape fails.
List/detail/XLSX-derived JSON duplicates are not counted twice.
Partial batches never delete missing courses or close missing offerings.

Carry-forward copies retain original collected_at and file hashes; null collected_at remains null. Previous batch/record ID mappings are recorded in validation_report_json; copying is not recollection.
Strict catalog source whitelist; unsupported sources are rejected.
All normalized links, evidence and indexes are built against one draft catalog version before activation.
Keep previous catalog versions referenced by recommendations.
Counts of course, offering, NCS module, NCS standard and missing curriculum are reported separately.
notes: The new manifest wraps the existing source payload; the team does not have to rename the supplied source fields. No new data collection has been performed by this design revision.
